latestChange.summary: Sync Metaflow Editor to SuperSplat Editor v2.28.0 and preserve Metaflow export, timeline, branding, and version surfaces

changes.summary: Version the active editor source as supersplat-v2.28.0 using the same original-repository plus version naming convention as the viewer baselines.
Expose Metaflow Editor 1.1 through source constants, console/About labels, runtime version JSON, structured history, and service worker cache naming.
Keep the Metaflow timeline frame cap at 100000 in src/ui/timeline-panel.ts.
Preserve upstream SOG HTML package export and add Metaflow legacy ZIP plus direct settings.json export.
Retain upstream BlobReadSource, BufferedReadStream 4MB buffering, and streaming zip project load behavior from v2.28.0.
